name: py-claim-stats
prompt: Add GET /claims/stats that returns {"total": N, "by_status": {status: count}} with every status present (0 when empty). Add tests. Run make test and make lint before finishing.

checks.run: uv run python -c 'from claims.app import App; a=App(); a.handle("POST","/claims",b"{\"policy_number\":\"P\",\"amount_cents\":5}"); s,d=a.handle("GET","/claims/stats"); assert s==200 and d["total"]==1 and d["by_status"]["submitted"]==1 and d["by_status"]["paid"]==0, d'
